lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to consecrate every firstborn male, both of man and beast, to Him.
For seven days the people eat unleavened bread, and they explain to their sons what the LORD did.
Every firstborn donkey must be redeemed with a goat, and every firstborn son must be redeemed.
God leads the people toward the Red Sea instead of through Philistine land, and Moses takes the bones of Jacob.
They camp at Etham, and the LORD goes before them in a pillar of cloud by day and fire by night.
